newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bidders to detail Creditanstalt offers.
newsitem.headline: Bidders to detail Creditanstalt offers.

text.p: Austrian Finance Minister Viktor Klima expects a consortium of bidders for government sell-off candidate Creditanstalt to present details of their offer later on Monday, Austrian news agency APA reported.

Savings bank Die Erste Oesterreichische Spar-Casse Bank has proposed to set up a joint holding company with Creditanstalt-Bankverein, but talks with its partners -- led by Austro-Italian insurer EA-Generali and Germany's Commerzbank -- were said to have been mired in difficulties.

According to unconfirmed press reports, Commerzbank over the weekend threatened to pull out of the consortium amid growing concern over the excessive weight Die Erste would carry in its proposed holding structure.
A spokesman for Die Erste said he was unable to comment on the reports. Commerzbank and the Austrian Finance Ministry also were both unavailable for comment.
Die Erste on Friday said agreement over a final bid for Austria's number two bank was still a long way off.
Finance Minister Viktor Klima, in charge of the sale, originally wanted to get a final offer for the government's 70 percent voting stake in Creditanstalt by the end of August.

The government has been trying to sell its stake in Creditanstalt, which has a strong presence in central and eastern Europe, for more than six years now. -- Knut Engelmann, Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
